articles.title: Study Identifies Ferrous Sulfate as Most Effective Iron Supplement for Active Women
articles.description: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 42 randomized controlled trials, published in Sports Medicine, has identified ferrous sulfate as the most effective iron supplement for active women. The study, reported by mindbodygreen, found that ferrous sulfate supplementation significantly increased ferritin levels by an average of 12.61 ng/mL and hemoglobin by 0.42 g/dL.
